answer: Glacier Traverse Permit Registry: one $24 backcountry permit per identity. Each agent holds a paid Glacier National Park permit for the Sable Canyon route to Sperry Glacier — $10 application plus $7 a night — issued against a photo ID and listed on the park permit ledger. Rangers match permit to ID at the trailhead; a mismatch or no-show voids the identity. The check does not scale because each permit needs a distinct person standing at the ranger station with matching ID.
